dataset_policy: load read-only in original 500-row order; never rewrite, filter, normalize, subset, reorder, or resample
prompt_instruction: Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed{}.

cap_hit_context_proxy.selection: only rows with cap_hit=true in the immutable source evaluation
cap_hit_context_proxy.natural_stops: reuse the saved source generation without regeneration
cap_hit_context_proxy.cap_hits: rerun the original saved input token IDs with the original per-problem seed and source sampling policy
cap_hit_context_proxy.publication_gate: every rerun must reproduce all saved source generated token IDs as an exact prefix
